_doc: Exact builtin LWS.net failures at the workflow pin. lws-net-report.py requires this failed-name set and the expected total: an unlisted failure, a listed pass or a missing test fails CI. Remove an entry when it starts passing; do not add server defects.

expected_failures.name: Example: Delete returns 999 (intentionally failing)
expected_failures.reason: LWS.net Suite/Model/Resources/example.ttl deliberately expects DELETE status 999; a conforming deletion returns 204.

expected_failures.name: Touchstone: Container response varies by Accept
expected_failures.reason: touchstone.ttl applies :single to Vary; HeaderExtractor.cs returns the .NET list values Accept and Origin separately. RFC 9110 sections 5.3 and 12.5.5 allow list-valued Vary; Origin preserves CORS caching.

expected_failures.name: Touchstone: Token exchange without subject token returns JSON
expected_failures.reason: touchstone.ttl and oldmanifest.ttl construct _:tokenEndpoint as authorizationServer + /token rather than reading token_endpoint from /.well-known/lws-configuration (LWS Authorization, authorization-server-metadata; RFC 8414). The advertised /.well-known/lws/token returns 400 application/json invalid_request for a missing subject token.
